title: PUBLIC WORKS COMMITTEE REPORT relative to temporarily closing the alley adjacent to 119 West Jefferson Boulevard between 33rd Street and Jefferson…
text:
[Council File 26-1153; CD 9]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
PUBLIC WORKS COMMITTEE REPORT relative to temporarily closing the alley adjacent to 119 West Jefferson Boulevard between 33rd Street and Jefferson Boulevard, pursuant to State Vehicle Code Section 21101.4.
Recommendations for Council action, pursuant to Motion (Price - Padilla):
INSTRUCT the City Engineer to report with recommendations to temporarily close the alley adjacent to 119 West Jefferson Boulevard between 33rd Street and Jefferson Boulevard, pursuant to State Vehicle Code Section 21101.4.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
Neither the City Administrative Officer nor the Chief Legislative Analyst has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Temporarily closes the alley next to 119 West Jefferson Boulevard, between 33rd Street and Jefferson Boulevard.
